wx.name: Amafayela wesimo sezulu
wx.notice: Unyaka ojwayelekile wesimo sezulu esiteshini esiseduze nemodeli yakho. Yiwo ajwayelekile ngokuvamile, hhayi isibikezelo kanye nesimo esimbi kakhulu. Ukubalwa kokuthobela kungase kudinge ifayela lesimo sezulu lalo: sebenzisa eliphawulwe yisiphathimandla sakho.
wx.place.none: Imodeli ayitsheli lapho imi. Thayipha ububanzi nobude (enyakatho nasempumalanga kuba yizinombolo ezihle, ngakho ubude baseCalifornia buba negatshana).
wx.sets.failed: Lawa masethi esimo sezulu awakwazanga ukufundwa njengamanje: {sets}.
wx.none: Akukho siteshi esingaphakathi kuka-400 km kumasethi esimo sezulu alo mengezo. Vula ifayela lesimo sezulu lakho kunalokho.
wx.far: Leli teshi likude ngo-{km} km. Isimo sezulu lapho wakha singahluka: hlola izibalo ngolwazi lwendawo.
wx.high: Leli teshiliphakeme noma liphansi ngo-{m} m kunendawo yemodeli. Izinga lokushisa liyehla cishe ngo-6.5 °C kuwo wonke amamitha angu-1,000 okukhuphuka, ngakho izibalo zalo ngeke zihambisane nendawo.
wx.ground.file: kusuka emazingeni okushisa omhlaba ajulile kakhulu efayelini
wx.ground.air: izinga lokushisa lomoya lonyaka, ukulinganisa kokuqala
wx.src.station: Izinga lokushisa lokuklama ngamazinga ashicilelwe iteshi, afakwe kwifayela lesimo sezulu. Izinsuku zokushisa zibalwa ngamahora onyaka ojwayelekile.
wx.src.year: Leli fayela alinawo amazinga okushisa okuklama ashicilelwe, ngakho izinga lokushisa lokuklama yilawo unyaka ojwayelekile olodwa ahlala ukhulu kunawo (noma uphansi kuwo) ngalesi sabelo samahora awo. Angahluka ngedigri noma ezimbili ezibalweni zesikhathi eside ezishicilelwe. Izinsuku zokushisa zibalwa ngalawo mahora afanayo.
wx.own.note: Ifayela lakho, {name}. Lihlala kule thebhu yesiphequluli.
wx.err.big: Leli fayela likhulu kakhulu ukuba unyaka wesimo sezulu.
wx.err.notepw: Lokho akuyona ifayela lesimo sezulu le-EnergyPlus (.epw).
wx.err.place: Ifayela lesimo sezulu alitsheli lapho iteshi lalo likhona.
wx.err.hours: Ifayela lesimo sezulu alibambi unyaka ophelele wamahora.
wx.err.row: Umugqa wefayela lesimo sezulu awukwazanga ukufundwa.
wx.err.missing: Ifayela lesimo sezulu linamahora angenalo izinga lokushisa lomoya.
wx.err.fetch: Ifayela lesimo sezulu aliphehliwe. Hlola uxhumo lwakho uzame futhi.
wx.err.sha: Ifayela lesimo sezulu elifike akuyona eliphawulwe yi-index, ngakho alisetshenziswanga.
wx.err.gunzip: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukukhipha ifayela lesimo sezulu.
wx.bim.none: Akukho zibalo zeteshi ezilingana namabhokisi e-Umthwalo wokufudumeza nokupholisa.
wx.bim.loads.done: Umthwalo wokufudumeza nokupholisa manje usebenzisa {te} °C ngaphandle ebusika, {ts} °C ehlobo kanye nezinsuku zokushisa ezingu-{dd}. Vula ithebhu ye-Daylight bese ucindezela Bala imithwalo.
wx.bim.year.done: Ukuhlola kwe-EnergyPlus manje kunalo {name} ukuze kusebenze unyaka owodwa.
wx.v.title: Unyaka wesimo sezulu
wx.v.f.period: Isikhathi sesikhombisa somoya, ichashi lesimo somoya nendlela yelanga
wx.v.set.bad: Lokho akuyona ifayela lezilungiselelo zalesi sibukeli. Akukho okushintshiwe.
wx.v.set.nocopy: Isiphequluli asivumanga ukukopisha. Sebenzisa Bonisa izilungiselelo njengombhalo.

wx.v.st.title: amateshi angu-{n}, abonakala ngemibala ngezinga lokushisa lokuklama lasehlobo
wx.v.st.hint: Chofoza iteshi ukuze uvule unyaka walo. Shift+chofoza ukuqhathanisa nelivuliwe.
wx.v.foot.share: amahora angu-{n} ({pct} %) angaphezulu noma alingana no-{level}
wx.v.nogl: Lesi siphequluli asinikezanga umdwebo ka-3D, ngakho indawo ibonakala njengemephu eyisicaba.
wx.v.keys: Izinkinobho: M okulandelayo inani (Shift+M okwangaphambili). X, C, V zishintsha izinsika zosuku, sesikhathi nenani. B ibhulokhi yokusika. T, Y, U zinyathela isikhathi, usuku nenani (Shift ibuyela emuva). 1 kuya ku-5 zikhetha ukubuka. Arrows zijikisa, W no-S zisondeza nokuhlehlisa, A no-D zishelelisa, F ilinganisa. Space iqala futhi imise ukunyakaza. Chofoza ichashi ukuze ubeke izinsika lapho, noma udonse insika ngomugqa wayo phezu kwendawo. Alt+chofoza noma Alt+donsa usethe insika yenani. Esc iyavala. Izikhathi zisesikhathini esijwayelekile seteshi.
wx.mh.wb: Kubalwe kusuka kumazinga okushisa omoya owomile, umswakama ohlobene noxinzelelo lwawo wonke amahora, ngezibalo ze-ASHRAE Handbook. Akuyona ikholomu yefayela.
wx.mh.w: Amagremu womhwamuko ngekhilogremu ngalinye lomoya owomile, kubalwe kusuka ezingeni lokushisa, umswakama noxinzelelo lwehora ngalinye. Akuyona ikholomu yefayela.
wx.mh.h: Ukushisa okubanjwe umoya oneminyezi ngekhilogremu ngalinye lomoya owomile, kubalwe kusuka ku-0 °C, kubalwe kusuka ezingeni lokushisa, umswakama noxinzelelo lwehora ngalinye. Kuboniswa ngo-kJ/kg kuzo zombili izinhlelo zamayunithi. Akuyona ikholomu yefayela.
wx.mh.dep: Izinga lokushisa lomoya owomile ngaphandle kwephoyinti lamanzi: ukuthi umoya ukude kangakanani nokugcwala.
wx.mh.alt: Amadigri phezu komkhathizwe maphakathi nehora ngalinye, kubalwe kusuka ebubanzini beteshi, ubude nesikhathi sesifunda. Ngaphansi kwezeru kubusuku. Akuyona ikholomu yefayela.
wx.share.unknown: Ixhumanisi libiza isiteshi sesimo sezulu okwengeziwe le-add-on esingasinaso.
wx.v.comfort.note: Ububanzi bokududuza ububanzi obulula bezinga lokushisa komoya nomswakama womoya obusetha wena. Akuyona izinga lokududuza: ayibandakanyi izinga lokushisa lokukhanya, isivinini somoya, izingubo nomsebenzi.
wx.v.comfort.count: Amahora {n} kwamahora {of} ({pct} %) phakathi kwezinga {t0} – {t1} nomswakama {rh0} % – {rh1} % womoya
wx.v.cmp.none: Khetha isiteshi sesibili ngaphansi kwe-Qhathanisa no, noma uphawule i-Shift bese uchofoza esithombeni seziteshi.
wx.v.cmp.nolist: Uhlu lweziteshi alulayishiwe, ngakho akukho okungaqhathaniswa nakho.
wx.v.cmp.diff: Isiteshi sokuqala ngaphandle kwesesibili (isilinganiso {mean}). Okubomvu: okokuqala kuphakeme. Okuluhlaza: okwesibili kuphakeme.
wx.v.edit.note: Phindaphinda noma wenze ushintsho kwenani elikhethiwe kuwo wonke amahora onyaka, ukuze uzame unyaka oshisa kakhulu noma isibhakabhaka esifiphele. Kuguqukayo kuphela lolo kholomu: umswakama awulandeli ushintsho lokushisa, nezimo zokuklama ezisekhanda lefayela ziyahlala njengoba zazinjalo. Amahora asekhaya ahlala engekho.
wx.v.edit.nofile: Ifayela qobo alikatholakali, ngakho ikopi eshintshiwe ayikwazi ukulondolozwa.
wx.v.edit.saved: Ifayela eshintshiwe lilondoloziwe. Umugqa wayo wesibili wokuphawula uchaza ukuthi yini eshintshiwe.
wx.v.share.none: Ixhumanisi lidinga isiteshi esivela kusethi yesimo sezulu. Ifayela lakho lihlala kwikhompyutha yakho, ngakho alikwazi ukuxhunyaniswa.
wx.v.share.copied: Ixhumanisi likopishiwe. Livulekela noma ubani osevule lo add-on.
wx.v.share.shown: Isiphequluli asivumelanga ukukopisha. Ixhumanisi likubhokisi elingezansi.
